subject: Mix > 트랙 오토메이션 생성 submenu leaf, as an undo-operation registration route
question: Does driving the leaf register its shipped undo operation, and does the bounded arrange-window census distinguish the paired undo states?

reverify.expected: with a selected region, the script reads 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소 after driving the leaf and exits 0
reverify.cost: needs Logic, an open project, and a selected region

canon.used_for: the submenu parent in the menu reading
the submenu leaf driven in the paired run

canon.value: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성
canon.used_for: the operation name in the Edit-menu undo-label readings
the description on the raw AX census rows

method: A three-note MIDI region from bars 1 through 3 was recorded on one instrument track. With the automation view on, the leaf was driven and the Edit-menu undo label was read. After Cmd-Z and Cmd-Shift-Z, the same arrange window was censused to depth 14 in each state. A separate view-off/view-on control read the checkbox and element totals.

observations.what: the submenu parent and the leaf driven
the paired undo-label and arrange-census states

states.undo_label: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소
리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소

observations.what: the two 오토메이션 값 AX rows

conclusion: Driving 리전 경계에 2개의 오토메이션 포인트 생성 registered Logic's undo operation named 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성. The paired depth-14 arrange-window census changed no AX element it can see: all three states had 719 elements and the (role, subrole, desc, title, roleDesc, value) multiset differences were zero in both directions. 오토메이션 값 was 1509949440 on both rows in this census whether the undo label named the operation or not, so that number is not a readback of the operation registered by the leaf.
limits: The undo label establishes that Logic registered the operation bearing its shipped name. It does not establish that the operation changed automation data, how many changes it made, or any position or value.
The paired claim is bounded to this arrange window and a depth-14 census. It does not establish that another window or a deeper AX element cannot distinguish the states.
The totals are readings of this project and this screen state, not constants of Logic.
오토메이션 값 AXHelp describes a whole-track automation/trim field and showing the parameter value at the playhead. That description does not measure what 1509949440 represents.
One ko-KR project, one instrument track, and one three-note MIDI region were measured.

What this supersedes in 2026-09-15-the-automation-lane-is-legible-and-inert is its reading that 오토메이션 값 carries no AXValue, its actuation of Mix > 트랙 오토메이션 생성 (a submenu PARENT, which carries no command identifier while every leaf does, so that actuation drove a container and not a command), and the conclusion it drew from them that no route measured there can create a point. Its other readings were NOT re-measured here and are not contradicted: 오토메이션 모드 reading Read and 오토메이션 파라미터 reading 볼륨 were seen again in this census, and nothing here re-tests settability on those elements.
